lines.text: Two friends walk toward each other, pass, turn around, and meet again.
lines.caption: Two friends walk toward each other, pass, turn around, and meet again.

lines.text: One number unlocks this whole puzzle. <short pause> It's the number THREE!
lines.caption: One number unlocks this whole puzzle. It's the number THREE!

lines.text: Hi there, I'm Vantee! Let's find out where that three comes from.
lines.caption: Hi there, I'm Vantee! Let's find out where that three comes from.

lines.text: Ann and Bo start at the same time from towns A and B.
lines.caption: Ann and Bo start at the same time from towns A and B.

lines.text: They walk toward each other on the same road, each at a steady speed.
lines.caption: They walk toward each other on the same road, each at a steady speed.

lines.text: They first meet 12 km from A.
lines.caption: They first meet 12 km from A.

lines.text: Each keeps walking to the other town, turns around at once, and walks back.
lines.caption: Each keeps walking to the other town, turns around at once, and walks back.

lines.text: They meet for the second time 10 km from A. How far apart are A and B?
lines.caption: They meet for the second time 10 km from A. How far apart are A and B?

lines.text: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.

lines.text: Let's break it down. Ann and Bo keep the same speeds the whole time.
lines.caption: Let's break it down. Ann and Bo keep the same speeds the whole time.

lines.text: The first meeting is 12 km from A.
lines.caption: The first meeting is 12 km from A.

lines.text: Each walker reaches the far town and turns around. Only then do they meet again, 10 km from A.
lines.caption: Each walker reaches the far town and turns around. Only then do they meet again, 10 km from A.

lines.text: We want the length of the road. Let's call it d.
lines.caption: We want the length of the road. Let's call it d.

lines.text: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Let's count how far they walk together, in whole road lengths.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Let's count how far they walk together, in whole road lengths.

lines.text: At the first meeting, Ann's part and Bo's part fill the road exactly once.
lines.caption: At the first meeting, Ann's part and Bo's part fill the road exactly once.

lines.text: So together they've walked one road length, and Ann's share is 12 km.
lines.caption: So together they've walked one road length, and Ann's share is 12 km.

lines.text: They walk on to the second meeting. Now let's line up every piece of both walks.
lines.caption: They walk on to the second meeting. Now let's line up every piece of both walks.

lines.text: Ann's first piece goes the whole way to B. That's one road length.
lines.caption: Ann's first piece goes the whole way to B. That's one road length.

lines.text: Bo walked the whole road to A. That's a second road length.
lines.caption: Bo walked the whole road to A. That's a second road length.

lines.text: Then Bo walked back from A to the meeting spot, and Ann walked back from B to it.
lines.caption: Then Bo walked back from A to the meeting spot, and Ann walked back from B to it.

lines.text: Together, those two pieces fill the road one more time. That makes three road lengths!
lines.caption: Together, those two pieces fill the road one more time. That makes three road lengths!

lines.text: Here's the key. Their speeds never change, so each road length together takes the same time.
lines.caption: Here's the key. Their speeds never change, so each road length together takes the same time.

lines.text: And in each one, Ann walks 12 km, just like the first time.
lines.caption: And in each one, Ann walks 12 km, just like the first time.

lines.text: Three road lengths means Ann walks 3 times 12, which is 36 km.
lines.caption: Three road lengths means Ann walks 3 times 12, which is 36 km.

lines.text: Now let's split her walk of 36 km into two parts.
lines.caption: Now let's split her walk of 36 km into two parts.

lines.text: First she walks the whole road to B. That's d.
lines.caption: First she walks the whole road to B. That's d.

lines.text: Then she walks back from B to the spot 10 km from A. That's d minus 10.
lines.caption: Then she walks back from B to the spot 10 km from A. That's d minus 10.

lines.text: So d plus d minus 10 equals 36.
lines.caption: So d plus d minus 10 equals 36.

lines.text: 2d equals 46, so d equals 23 km. That's Choice D!
lines.caption: 2d equals 46, so d equals 23 km. That's Choice D!

lines.text: Let's walk it. Ann goes 23 km to B, then 13 back, ending 10 km from A!
lines.caption: Let's walk it. Ann goes 23 km to B, then 13 back, ending 10 km from A!

lines.text: Here's a second way. Let's follow Bo instead.
lines.caption: Here's a second way. Let's follow Bo instead.

lines.text: At the first meeting, Bo has walked the rest of the road. That's d minus 12.
lines.caption: At the first meeting, Bo has walked the rest of the road. That's d minus 12.

lines.text: By the second meeting he walks 3 times as far, for the same reason as Ann: 3 groups of d minus 12.
lines.caption: By the second meeting he walks 3 times as far, for the same reason as Ann: 3 groups of d minus 12.

lines.text: He walked the whole road to A, then 10 km back. That's d plus 10.
lines.caption: He walked the whole road to A, then 10 km back. That's d plus 10.

lines.text: So 3d minus 36 equals d plus 10.
lines.caption: So 3d minus 36 equals d plus 10.

lines.text: 2d equals 46 again, so d is 23. It matches!
lines.caption: 2d equals 46 again, so d is 23. It matches!

lines.text: Which way to pick? Follow the walker whose first distance you know. Here, that's Ann.
lines.caption: Which way to pick? Follow the walker whose first distance you know. Here, that's Ann.

lines.text: Let's test every choice. Ann always walks 36 km. Where does she end up?
lines.caption: Let's test every choice. Ann always walks 36 km. Where does she end up?

lines.text: Choice A, 18, is half of 36. That puts her back at A, not 10 km away.
lines.caption: Choice A, 18, is half of 36. That puts her back at A, not 10 km away.

lines.text: Choice B, 21, comes from no step at all. She would end up 6 km from A.
lines.caption: Choice B, 21, comes from no step at all. She would end up 6 km from A.

lines.text: Choice C, 22, just adds 12 and 10. She would end up 8 km from A.
lines.caption: Choice C, 22, just adds 12 and 10. She would end up 8 km from A.

lines.text: Choice E, 26, says Ann walked back only 10. But she walks back from B, not from A!
lines.caption: Choice E, 26, says Ann walked back only 10. But she walks back from B, not from A!

lines.text: With 26, she'd end up 16 km from A. Only 23 lands on 10!
lines.caption: With 26, she'd end up 16 km from A. Only 23 lands on 10!

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Same story, new numbers.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Same story, new numbers.

lines.text: The first meeting is 7 km from A. The second is 5 km from B.
lines.caption: The first meeting is 7 km from A. The second is 5 km from B.

lines.text: Watch out, that's from B this time! How far apart are the towns?
lines.caption: Watch out, that's from B this time! How far apart are the towns?

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. Three road lengths again, so Ann walks 3 times 7, which is 21.
lines.caption: Let's check. Three road lengths again, so Ann walks 3 times 7, which is 21.

lines.text: She walks the whole road to B, then 5 km back. That's d plus 5.
lines.caption: She walks the whole road to B, then 5 km back. That's d plus 5.

lines.text: So d plus 5 equals 21, and d is 16 km!
lines.caption: So d plus 5 equals 21, and d is 16 km!

lines.text: Check with Bo. He walks 9 km at first, so 27 in all.
lines.caption: Check with Bo. He walks 9 km at first, so 27 in all.

lines.text: That's 16 to A, then 11 back, which is 5 km from B. It works!
lines.caption: That's 16 to A, then 11 back, which is 5 km from B. It works!

lines.text: If you found 16 km, amazing work!
lines.caption: If you found 16 km, amazing work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea. By the first meeting, together they've walked the road once.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea. By the first meeting, together they've walked the road once.

lines.text: By the second meeting, it's three times. So each walker goes three times as far!
lines.caption: By the second meeting, it's three times. So each walker goes three times as far!

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
